constraints.constraint: 2048 % gemm.M.mram == 0
2048 % gemm.N.mram == 0
2048 % gemm.K.mram == 0
(gemm.M.wram | gemm.M.mram)
(gemm.N.wram | gemm.N.mram)
(gemm.K.wram | gemm.K.mram)
(gemm.M.mram | 2048)
(gemm.N.mram | 2048)
(gemm.K.mram | 2048)
prod(extent / block) == dpus * tasklets
tasklets * sum of operand tiles <= mram (assuming no sharing)
tasklets * sum of operand tiles <= wram (assuming no sharing)
input 0's mram tile must be a whole number of 8-byte DMA granules, i.e. a multiple of 2 elements
input 1's mram tile must be a whole number of 8-byte DMA granules, i.e. a multiple of 2 elements
output 0's mram tile must be a whole number of 8-byte DMA granules, i.e. a multiple of 2 elements
gemm.order: item 0 takes one of the first (number active) places when it is active
gemm.order: item 0 takes a place past the active ones when it is inactive
gemm.order: items 0 and 1 keep index order while both are inactive (symmetry)
gemm.order: items 0 and 2 keep index order while both are inactive (symmetry)
gemm.order: item 1 takes one of the first (number active) places when it is active
gemm.order: item 1 takes a place past the active ones when it is inactive
gemm.order: items 1 and 2 keep index order while both are inactive (symmetry)
gemm.order: item 2 takes one of the first (number active) places when it is active
gemm.order: item 2 takes a place past the active ones when it is inactive

params.name: dpus
params.doc: number of DPUs the workgroup spans (ATiM: product of blockIdx extents)

params.name: gemm.M.mram
params.doc: mram tile size of iteration dim M (extent 2048) of cinm.op.gemm; per LEAF -- across all dims, prod(extent/tile) == dpus*tasklets, so one such tile per (dpu, tasklet) worker, not per DPU; must divide the extent

params.name: gemm.M.wram
params.doc: wram tile size of iteration dim M (extent 2048) of cinm.op.gemm; must divide the previous level's tile

params.name: gemm.N.mram
params.doc: mram tile size of iteration dim N (extent 2048) of cinm.op.gemm; per LEAF -- across all dims, prod(extent/tile) == dpus*tasklets, so one such tile per (dpu, tasklet) worker, not per DPU; must divide the extent

params.name: gemm.N.wram
params.doc: wram tile size of iteration dim N (extent 2048) of cinm.op.gemm; must divide the previous level's tile

params.name: gemm.K.mram
params.doc: mram tile size of iteration dim K (extent 2048) of cinm.op.gemm; per LEAF -- across all dims, prod(extent/tile) == dpus*tasklets, so one such tile per (dpu, tasklet) worker, not per DPU; must divide the extent

params.name: gemm.K.wram
params.doc: wram tile size of iteration dim K (extent 2048) of cinm.op.gemm; must divide the previous level's tile

params.name: gemm.order
params.doc: which iteration dim occupies which workgroup axis (cnm.workgroup_dim_order). An item is active only when its dim is actually distributed (extent / mram tile > 1); see the encoding note
params.encoding: dimension k holds the 1-based place of item k; place 1 is the outermost workgroup axis (slowest-varying across leaves, cnm.workgroup_dim_order position 0). Items declared conditionally active take the low places when active; inactive items are forced to the remaining high places in item-index order.
